decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch close to the firm’s core modular lighting offer, backed by a multi-model line and its own web page in a growing industry, this product carries enough investment and visible commitment that management would be very likely to continue it rather than admit an early mistake.

This ceiling luminaire is likewise a core-adjacent 2023 product line with visible market presentation and no clear sign of failure, so under escalation of commitment the firm would most likely keep it and interpret any weak early uptake as temporary.
